requirement:
Create `app/validators.py` with `is_valid_isbn13(value: str) -> bool`. Hyphens and spaces are ignored. A valid ISBN-13 has exactly 13 digits after cleaning and a correct checksum: the weighted sum of the digits (weights alternate 1,3,1,3,... from the left, including the check digit) must be divisible by 10. Anything else (letters, wrong length, empty string, bad checksum) returns False and must never raise.
The project must also contain `app/main.py` defining a FastAPI `app` (entry point `app.main:app`) (no endpoints required) and `app/__init__.py`. Include unit tests (pytest).
acceptance_criteria: Valid ISBN-13 values are accepted with or without hyphens/spaces
Bad checksums and malformed input return False without raising

rubric.partial: hidden_pass_rate is the fraction of hidden tests passed; reported separately
